item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.7.1

SupaSidebar 1.7.1 brings linked profile windows to the front, keeps Live Tabs steady as you close tabs, lets Hover Delay reach 0s, and locks the MCP connection with an access key.

Improvements

  • Hover Delay Down to 0s - Set Hover Delay to 0s and the sidebar appears the moment your cursor reaches the screen edge.
  • Room Past the Last Live Tab - Live Tabs now scrolls a little past the last tab, so it no longer sits against the bottom bar.
  • Clearer Linked Profile Loading - Live Tabs now says when it’s opening a window or loading its tabs, and why a list is empty.
  • Onboarding Built Around Your Browser - New users get ⌃Tab on its own screen, and the Command Panel and browser keys screens show what each one replaces.

Bug Fixes

  • Grant Access now adds SupaSidebar to the Accessibility list, so you no longer have to add it with +.
  • Switching to a Space linked to a closed browser profile now brings its new window to the front and loads its tabs.
  • Clicking another browser after closing a linked profile’s window now switches to that browser’s Space.
  • Closing a linked profile’s window with ⌘W now brings the sidebar back and switches to the Space of the window behind it.
  • Closing Live Tabs at the end of a scrolled list now slides the next tab under your pointer instead of the one above it.
  • With Stage Manager on, clicking a Live Tab in a minimized window now brings that window to the front.
  • Websites can no longer send commands to SupaSidebar’s MCP connection, which now requires a private access key.

Notes

  • If an AI app reaches SupaSidebar through MCP, update supasidebar-mcp to 0.2.4 or later, since older versions can no longer connect.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: New setups now use a browser-aware flow that helps you choose useful sites, configure how SupaSidebar opens, and reach your first working sidebar faster.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field, jump directly to the right section, and change supported toggles from the results.
  • Scoped Search Shortcuts: Assign optional shortcuts that open the Command Panel directly in the Live Tabs or Saved scope.
  • Precise Auto-Close Duration: Choose a custom timeout using any combination of days, hours, and minutes.
  • Local Folder Preview Sorting: Order files and subfolders by Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Date Modified Newest, or Date Modified Oldest. Name sorting handles numbered files naturally, so Export 2 appears before Export 10.

Improvements

  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.
  • Auto-Show Is Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar does not appear automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Command Panel shortcut hints now adapt better when the panel has limited space.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs search no longer hides an open tab when the same URL is also saved in SupaSidebar.
  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

Notes

  • Local Folder Preview Sorting applies to Finder-style folder preview columns. It does not rearrange your saved SupaSidebar folders.
